description: Before a heavy job, send how much memory the machine your agent runs on has free (free -m, os.freemem()) and what you are about to run. Get a memory warning and a verdict: run_local, or offload with the provider to use. Free watch-only logs would_offload for the weekly report; nothing runs.

floor_mb.description: Keep at least this much free. Default 2048.

free_mb.description: Free or available memory right now, in MB (Linux: the "available" column of free -m).

host.description: Optional name of the machine, e.g. "my-laptop".

job.description: The command or a short description, e.g. "npm run build" or "playwright crawl of 40 pages".

job_mb.description: Optional: your own estimate of the job's peak memory in MB. Without it we use a rough guess by job type.

name: check_memory
